title: EDISCO: Equivariant DIScrete Diffusion for Euclidean Combinatorial Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.04953v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Euclidean combinatorial optimization problems (ECOPs), such as the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) and Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP), possess inherent symmetries under the two-dimensional Euclidean group E(2), including rotations, reflections, and translations. Existing learning-based methods, including recent diffusion-based methods, rely on data augmentation or regularization to approximate E(2)-equivariance. This paper presents EDISCO, the first discrete diffusion model for ECOPs with exact E(2)-invariant generative distributions over node-index solutions. EDISCO introduces an E(2)-equivariant edge-score network coupled with a categorical continuous-time Markov chain over discrete edge variables, and exact posterior sampling provides efficient multi-step inference. translated_title: EDISCO：面向欧几里得组合优化的等变离散扩散模型
translated_abstract: 欧几里得组合优化问题（ECOPs），例如旅行商问题（TSP）和带容量约束的车辆路径问题（CVRP），在二维欧几里得群E(2)下具有固有的对称性，包括旋转、反射和平移。现有的基于学习的方法，包括近期的基于扩散的方法，都依赖数据增强或正则化来近似实现E(2)等变性。本文提出了EDISCO，这是首个针对ECOPs的离散扩散模型，其生成分布在节点索引解上具有精确的E(2)不变性。EDISCO引入了一个E(2)等变的边评分网络，与作用在离散边变量上的分类型连续时间马尔可夫链相耦合，并通过精确后验采样实现高效的多步推理。这种设计赋予EDISCO一种局部几何归纳偏置：具有相同相对几何结构和组合上下文的边邻域会被一致地表示
tldr: EDISCO是首个面向欧几里得组合优化问题、生成分布具有精确E(2)不变性的离散扩散模型，它通过等变边评分网络与连续时间马尔可夫链相结合，实现高效的多步推理，无需依赖数据增强或正则化。
en_tdlr: EDISCO is the first discrete diffusion model for Euclidean combinatorial optimization with exact E(2)-invariant generative distributions, coupling an equivariant edge-score network with a continuous-time Markov chain to enable efficient multi-step inference without relying on data augmentation or regularization.
